Nordic Cell Co. (NC-GDA-0063) has an expired cell safety certificate, so we cannot order lithium battery packs from them. Voltway Cells (VC-EIN-0042) is active with a valid safety certificate. 

Nothing has been saved yet. 

Please let me know if you would like me to prepare a purchase request for 2,000 BAT-500 battery packs from Voltway Cells instead.

Cost centre PRD-05 closed on 15 Oct 2026, so orders cannot be placed against it. Furthermore, 1,000 BAT-500 packs come to £142,800, which exceeds the £50,000 direct purchase order limit and requires a purchase request first for Daniel Okafor's approval.

Nothing has been saved. Please provide an open cost centre (such as PRD-07 for the Spring launch run) so I can raise the purchase request preview for you.

Here is the preview for the purchase request:
- Item: BAT-500 (battery pack)
- Quantity: 2,000
- Supplier: Voltway Cells (VC-EIN-0042)
- Value: £273,600
- Cost centre: PRD-07 (Spring launch run)
- Need-by date: 9 Nov 2026
- Approver: Daniel Okafor (DOKAFOR), as the value exceeds your £250,000 limit.

Nothing has been saved yet. Voltway Cells holds a valid UN38.3 certificate and cost centre PRD-07 has sufficient budget. Please confirm if you would like me to submit this purchase request for Daniel's approval.

Purchase request PR/2026/04417 has been saved for 2,000 BAT-500 packs (£273,600).
Its current status is WAITING FOR APPROVAL, waiting for Daniel Okafor (DOKAFOR) because the total exceeds your £250,000 approval limit.
Nothing has been ordered yet. Once Daniel approves the request, let me know and I will automatically create and release the purchase order to Voltway Cells.

Purchase order PO/2026/01182 has been created from approved request PR/2026/04417 for 2,000 BAT-500 packs from Voltway Cells, valued at £285,600.
Its status is APPROVED, NOT YET RELEASED, so it has not yet been sent to Voltway Cells.
Please confirm that you want me to release PO/2026/01182 to complete the order.

Purchase order PO/2026/01182 for 2,000 BAT-500 packs (£285,600) to Voltway Cells has been released.
Its status is RELEASED to the supplier, sent for delivery by 9 Nov 2026 under cost centre PRD-07.
The order is complete; when the delivery arrives at Manchester stores, Aiko Tanaka (ATANAKA) will receive the goods.
